title: RT-Lynx: Putting GEMM Sparsity in the Right Place for Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.26632v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiT) achieve strong performance in image generation but incur substantial inference costs. While prior work has reduced this cost via quantization and distillation, semi-structured sparsity, which can nearly halve FLOPs, remains underexplored. A key reason is that most existing approaches focus on weight sparsification, and pruning 50% of the weights can remove critical model capacity and degrade generation quality. Our study, however, shows that DiT activations are intrinsically sparse and significantly more robust to N:M semi-structured sparsification than weights. Motivated by this observation, we advocate a paradigm shift from weight sparsification to activation sparsification. We propose RT-Lynx, which applies N:M sparsification to activations and incorporates error-compensation techniques to mitigate accuracy loss. translated_title: RT-Lynx：为扩散模型在正确位置实现GEMM稀疏性
translated_abstract: 摘要：扩散变换器（DiT）在图像生成方面表现出色，但推理成本高昂。尽管先前的工作通过量化和蒸馏降低了这一成本，但半结构化稀疏性（可近乎减半浮点运算量）仍未得到充分探索。关键原因在于，大多数现有方法侧重于权重稀疏化，而剪枝50%的权重会移除关键模型容量并降低生成质量。然而，我们的研究表明，DiT激活值本质上是稀疏的，并且对N:M半结构化稀疏化的鲁棒性显著高于权重。基于这一观察，我们倡导从权重稀疏化向激活稀疏化的范式转变。我们提出了RT-Lynx，该方法对激活值应用N:M稀疏化，并结合误差补偿技术来缓解精度损失。我们进一步实现了针对此设置高度优化的CUDA内核，实现了最高可达的性能提升。
tldr: 本文提出RT-Lynx，通过将稀疏性从权重转向激活值，利用DiT激活的固有稀疏性，结合误差补偿和定制CUDA内核，实现扩散模型推理成本的大幅降低。
en_tdlr: RT-Lynx shifts sparsity from weights to activations, leveraging DiT's intrinsic activation sparsity with error compensation and custom CUDA kernels to significantly reduce inference cost.
